about.title: From first web pages to complex applications.
about.paragraph1: I'm a Senior Frontend Developer specialising in Vue.js, with experience building systems for the hospitality and insurance industries. I care about readable code, comfortable interfaces and solutions that are easy to maintain and grow.
about.paragraph2: I built my first HTML pages back in middle school. Over time that interest turned into a profession, and simple pages gave way to complex applications. I still enjoy learning new technologies and looking for better ways to solve problems. In my day-to-day work I also use AI to build and develop applications.
